documents.title: Facilities Handover Notes – December 15, 2025
documents.content:
**Facilities Handover Notes – December 15, 2025**

**Date:** Mon 12/15/25
**Shift:** 2:30 PM – 11:00 PM (C. Reyes)
**Handing off to:** J. Okafor (Overnight, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM)

**Weather note:** Cold front came through around 4 PM. Temp dropped fast, wind out of the NW. Loading dock door #2 was left cracked for about 20 min during the furniture delivery – keep an eye on that area, East Gallery temp read a little low after.

---

**HVAC / Climate Control System (CCS)**

- CCS running normal all shift. No alarms on the panel. East Gallery held at 68–69°F, RH 45–48%. West Wing held 67–68°F.
- Climate Control System last_maintenance_date 2025-11-20. Record status: current. Next PM is due in January – I left a sticky note on the desk with the vendor number. They wanted to come in early Jan but we said the week of the 12th is better, after the holiday closure.
- **URGENT:** The condensate line under the air handler in the basement (unit AHU-2) was dripping again this morning. It's the same spot as last month. I put a bucket under it and taped a sign. The drip is slow – about a cup every 2 hours. Do NOT let the bucket overflow. Please log the drip rate on the clipboard next to the unit. If it gets faster than a cup an hour, page Carlos on the overnight radio.
- The thermostat in the Conservation Lab has been reading 2° off from the wall sensor. Not a big deal, we've been using the handheld hygrometer to double-check. I recalibrated the wall sensor at 5 PM, it's holding steady now. Keep an eye on it tonight.
- Filter change for CCS is scheduled for Thursday. The 20x20x2 filters are in the supply closet, top shelf, labeled "CCS FILTERS." There are 4 boxes of 6. We need 3 boxes for the change. After the change, put the used ones in the bin behind the shop – the pickup is Friday morning.

---

**Security / Patrols**

- Patrols completed on schedule: 3 PM, 5 PM, 7 PM, 9 PM.
- All exterior doors secure. No issues.
- 10-4 on the door alarm test at 6:30 PM – all zones responded.
- The motion sensor in the North Corridor (sensor NC-2) is still giving occasional false triggers. It went off at 4:45 PM – no cause found, reset it. This is the third time this week. I flagged it in the alarm log. The vendor was supposed to look at it last week but rescheduled. I left a voicemail for the vendor (Mike) this afternoon. If it goes off again tonight, just reset it and note the time. Don't call the police unless you see something.
- Visitor count today: 214. Last one out at 4:50 PM. All clear after closing.

---

**Exhibits / Collection Care**

- **East Gallery, Case 12:** The new acquisition (the ceramic vase, accession #2025.17) is on display. The case locks are working fine. Do not open the case for any reason – the curator (Dr. Patel) is the only one who has the key. She said she'll be in tomorrow morning around 9 AM to check on it.
- **West Wing, Painting Wall:** The humidity in the West Wing dipped to 42% for about 15 minutes this afternoon after the loading dock door was cracked. It's back up to 45% now. I noted it in the environmental log. It shouldn't be a problem, but if it dips below 40% tonight, call the Facilities Manager on call (not the regular line – the number is on the red card on the fridge).
- The light meter readings for the Textile Gallery are due this week. The handheld meter is in the top drawer of the workbench, fully charged. Readings should be taken at 10 AM, 1 PM, and 4 PM, three days in a row. I didn't get to start it today – it's on the list for tomorrow. Please remind the day shift.
- The new exhibit labels for the Photography Wing arrived. They're in the brown box on the receiving table. Do not open the box – the registrar needs to inventory them first. She's coming in Wednesday.

---

**Maintenance / Other**

---

**Reminders for Overnight Shift (J. Okafor)**

- Check the bucket under AHU-2 at 1 AM and 4 AM. Log the drip rate.
- Patrols at 12 AM, 2 AM, 4 AM, 6 AM.
- The front door is locked with the deadbolt – do not use the push bar to exit; use the key.
- If the alarm panel beeps (it does that sometimes), it's the low battery warning on the keypad. Press "silence" and it'll be fine until morning. Do not call the monitoring company – they'll send a truck and we'll get charged.
- Coffee in the break room is fresh – I made a pot at 10:30 PM. There's a second bag in the cabinet.
